description.value: The Wee Chippie is a casual British-style fish and chips restaurant located in a strip mall on the Lougheed Highway in Mission, BC. It offers both dine-in and takeout service, with delivery also available through Skip The Dishes and DoorDash. For cyclists riding the Lougheed corridor, it would serve as a hearty, sit-down refuelling stop in the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theweechippie.ca is accessible and confirms the business is actively operating for dine-in and takeout at A4-32081 Lougheed Hwy, Mission BC, with phone 604-289-1998 — the OSM community field incorrectly lists Chilliwack while both the website and URL discovery notes place it in Mission, BC. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by website text and delivery platform listings; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, leaving all required WWC criteria unverifiable. The website copyright date of 2013 suggests it is rarely updated, though the content describes current operations.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but the business is located in Mission, BC — the OSM community tag should be corrected.
Phone number 604-289-1998 sourced from website only; no phone is present in OSM tags.
Website copyright reads '© 2013', indicating it has not been meaningfully updated in over a decade, though current operational content is present.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly open and legitimate, but all three WWC required criteria (bike parking or visibility, water bottle refill, washrooms) are unconfirmed from available website content; on-the-ground verification is needed before listing.
